# ANSCER Robotics

> ANSCER Robotics builds autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), autonomous pallet stackers, automated guided vehicles (AGVs), and fleet management software for factory and warehouse intralogistics. Payload capacities range from 100kg to 2000kg, covering tote and bin transport, cart towing, line feeding, pallet moving, and high-rack stacking.

Product families:

- **AR Series** — modular AMRs (250kg–1250kg) with LiDAR SLAM navigation and swappable top modules.
- **PSR Series** — autonomous pallet stackers and reach stackers (500kg–2000kg) for dock-to-stock and vertical racking, plus the PSR Trail tugger for multi-cart milk runs.
- **AGV Series** — QR/track-guided AGVs for fixed-path line feeding and small-parts handling.
- **Software** — ANSCER FMS, a VDA 5050 compliant fleet management system with dynamic traffic routing and WMS/MES integration.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://anscer.com/): Automate factory material movement with modular AMRs, pallet stackers, and fleet software.
- [All Robots](https://anscer.com/products): Full fleet of autonomous mobile robots and AGVs for payload handling from 100kg to 2000kg. Compare models and specifications.
- [Software Solutions — AMR Fleet Management System (FMS)](https://anscer.com/solutions): Orchestrate multi-robot AMR fleets. VDA 5050 compliance, dynamic traffic routing, and turnkey WMS/MES integration.

## AR Series (modular AMRs)

- [AR Series Overview](https://anscer.com/products/ar): Modular AMRs from 250kg to 1250kg with LiDAR SLAM navigation and swappable top modules for flexible intralogistics.
- [AR 250](https://anscer.com/products/ar/ar250): 250kg payload AMR for light load transport. Compact footprint, dynamic obstacle avoidance, WMS integration.
- [AR 500](https://anscer.com/products/ar/ar500): 500kg payload AMR for mid-weight factory transport of bins, totes, and carts.
- [AR 650](https://anscer.com/products/ar/ar650): 650kg payload AMR for medium-to-heavy shop floor logistics, sub-assembly lines, cart towing, and roller conveyors.
- [AR 1250](https://anscer.com/products/ar/ar1250): 1250kg heavy payload AMR with industrial-grade LiDAR SLAM and robust chassis engineering.

## PSR Series (pallet stackers & tuggers)

- [PSR Series Overview](https://anscer.com/products/psr): Automate pallet transport, stacking, and racking. Eliminate forklift hazards and accelerate dock-to-stock workflows.
- [PSR G2G](https://anscer.com/products/psr/psrg2g): Ground-to-ground autonomous pallet mover for receiving, staging, and assembly transfers.
- [PSR 2000](https://anscer.com/products/psr/psr2000): Heavy-duty pallet stacking AMR up to 2000kg, built for continuous 24/7 warehouse operations and ERP dispatch.
- [PSR 2000R](https://anscer.com/products/psr/psr2000r): Autonomous reach stacker up to 2000kg for high-density vertical pallet storage and zero-accident racking.
- [PSR 1000R](https://anscer.com/products/psr/psr1000r): Autonomous pallet reach stacker for 1000kg vertical stacking in narrow aisles with high-rack precision sensors.
- [LBR 500](https://anscer.com/products/psr/lbr500): Low-bay lifter AMR, 500kg payload, for low-clearance warehouse racks.
- [PSR Trail](https://anscer.com/psr-trail): Autonomous tugger robot for multi-cart milk runs and assembly line towing, with hybrid sensor fusion localization and deep learning pallet perception.

## AGV Series (guided vehicles)

- [AGV Series Overview](https://anscer.com/products/agv): Cost-effective, high-reliability AGVs for fixed-path line feeding and carton handling.
- [AGV 100](https://anscer.com/products/agv/agv100): QR-guided material handling robot for totes, bins, and small parts up to 100kg.
